QUOTE: "The deny list is a hard stop that runs later, at execution, and is not bypassed by approval." and "`ServerManager::execute(name, args)` ... PermissionManager::is_denied(name, pattern) → error JSON 'Permission denied'; route_tool_call"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer places is_denied in ServerManager::execute before routing, but it doesn't conclude that deny is the only list blocking execution. It describes the allow list as gating approval, and it says "Only the deny list and the auto_approve_tools/allow logic gate calls."
